payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Blackwell (SM100): CuTeDSL CLC
payload.what: **Practical Experience**: - CLC is better suited than static scheduling for irregular workloads (e.g., causal attention's triangular tile distribution) - CLC implements work-stealing in hardware, which is faster than software atomic operations - For square matrix GEMM (uniform workload), CLC performance is close to that of static scheduling

scheduler = PersistentTileSchedulerSm100(

)
work_tile = scheduler.get_current_work()

    # Process tile
    compute(work_tile)
    work_tile = scheduler.advance_to_next_work()
